# AI API 比价雷达与中转站导航

Chinese price radar and directory for AI API relay services, with multipliers normalized against official vendor pricing.

Keywords: AI API 比价, 中转站价格榜, API 中转站, 综合倍率, 充值系数, 分组倍率, 官方 API 价格, 免费 API, 低价 API, OpenAI API, GPT API, Claude API, Codex API, Grok API, Gemini API, DeepSeek API, GLM API, Kimi API, New API, One API, CC Switch.

Human-readable site: index.html
Official baseline prices: data/models.json
Station price quotes: data/offers.json
Normalization settings: data/pricing-config.json
Site directory data: data/sites.json
Contribution and verification policy: CONTRIBUTING.md

Multipliers are normalized as station price divided by the official vendor price, both in CNY per million tokens. Quotes whose top-up basis is not disclosed are shown with their raw station ratio and are excluded from the ranked list. Status and price notes are time-sensitive. A reachable registration page does not guarantee successful registration, current model availability, free quota, price, reliability, or data security. Never publish API keys, cookies, account credentials, session tokens, or private URLs in this repository.
